notes: Authoritative GitHub Update Feed: fixes repeated stale release detection from raw.githubusercontent.com branch URLs. When the configured update feed is a GitHub raw branch URL, Agent City now resolves the same repository/ref/file through GitHub's repository contents API and requests the raw file directly from repository state. The previous cache-busted raw request remains as a fallback for temporary API failures or non-GitHub feeds. Saved feed URLs remain unchanged. This release includes all v0.9.10 3D world-space cluster behavior.
